about: Default event types for the attendee upload formatter, from the ImpCommEventType table. Course name is matched against Sheet 1 column L (Course Name), ignoring capitals and extra spaces: it is the table's EventTypeNotes where that holds the CITI course name, otherwise the TypeName (a blank course name on the page also uses the TypeName). To change the defaults everyone starts with, edit this file, or use Download event types on the page and replace this file with it.
